name: 2-bromomescaline
summary: 2-Bromomescaline (2-BM or 2-Br-M), also known as 2-bromo-3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine, is a putative psychedelic drug of the scaline family and derivative of the phenethylamine hallucinogen mescaline which has an unusual 2-bromo substitution.

pharmacology.text: It is an agonist for serotonin receptors, with a binding affinity of 215 nM at 5-HT1A, 513 nM at 5-HT2A and 379 nM at 5-HT2C, so while it is around 10 times more tightly binding than mescaline at 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptors, it is over 20 times more potent at 5-HT2C.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It has been reported as a designer drug, first identified in Austria in January 2023.
